review.publication: Local only. No commit, push or deployment.
review.scope: Plane geometry, circle/disk translations, finite segments versus lines, geometric lengths, and plane-angle quantities, units and instruments.
review.attribution: Reviewed adaptations of Open English WordNet 2025 by the Open English WordNet Team, derived from Princeton WordNet. Retain CC BY 4.0 and underlying Princeton notices in docs/quality/2026-10-09-q11.md#sources-and-reuse. BIPM quantities and units, OpenStax explanations, Wolfram geometry definitions, and manufacturer instrument descriptions are cited as supporting evidence; labels, restrictions and graph mappings are original reviewed adaptations.
review.context_policy: All new concepts and assertions use U1 and unspecified strength. Preserve existing home contexts, all grammar rows, and empty U2.

sense_decisions.scope: A geometric figure lying within a plane, including curves and filled figures. Being planar does not require intrinsic dimension two; do not import that restrictive gloss as a dimension assertion.
A curve lying in one plane. The mathematical curve sense includes straight lines and segments, unlike the dictionary changing-direction-only curve gloss.
A planar curve forming a closed loop. Merely having no endpoints does not make an infinite straight line a closed loop; closed-set topology is a different condition.
A complete straight geometric line extending indefinitely in both directions. A finite segment or ray is a subset, not a species, of such a complete line.
The finite straight geometric segment joining two endpoints, including the points between them. It is an object, not its length and not an infinite line.

A finite segment joining two points on a curve. Circle chords are a common case; musical chords and graph-theoretic cycle chords are excluded. A spherical diameter also joins points of a great circle.
A segment from the centre of a circle to its boundary, or from a sphere centre to its surface. Distinct from the length, arm bone, spoke and service-region meanings.
A continuous proper portion of a circle, with endpoints. Being part of a circle does not make it a circle subtype; exclude a full circle from this selected proper-arc sense.
The length of a circle or sphere radius segment. The segment and its length are separate concepts; do not import the bare variable letter r as a lexical synonym.
Length measured along a rectifiable curve or its specified portion, including a circular arc. This is broader than circular-arc length and is not the straight chord distance.
The length around a plane figure boundary where that length is defined. Distinct from the boundary itself, a security perimeter, or an area.
The length of a full circle, also the perimeter of its disk. Distinct from the boundary curve denoted by the existing circumference term.
The geometric configuration of two rays sharing an endpoint in a plane, distinct from the plane-angle quantity. The broader angle record keeps its possible nonplanar meanings.
The measurable plane-angle quantity, distinct from its geometric configuration and from solid angle. SI treats it as dimensionless while retaining the meaningful radian unit.
A unit for plane angle. This selected family excludes solid-angle units even though the broad dictionary angular-unit family includes them.
The coherent SI plane-angle unit. Its symbol rad is distinct from the RAD software-development acronym and the absorbed-dose unit rad.
A sixtieth of a degree of plane angle. Do not import the unqualified time-unit word minute as an equivalent term.
A sixtieth of an arcminute. This is a plane-angle unit, distinct from a second of time.
Determine the plane-angle quantity, distinct from drawing its geometric representation.
Determine radial length, not the radius segment as an object.
Determine length along the selected curve portion rather than the chord distance.
Determine the length around the selected boundary.
Determine the full circle boundary length.
Determine the side-to-side length quantity, not area.
A measuring instrument intended to determine angles. Do not align the generic class with OEWN goniometer, whose selected dictionary meaning is radio direction finding.
Select the graduated drafting instrument for measuring plane angles. Other drawing functions are not represented as measurement targets.
An electronic angle-measuring instrument. Model-specific spirit-level features, accuracy and operating ranges are not universal properties.
Select the vernier angle gauge with a movable blade, supported by the manufacturer. Do not restrict all angle instruments or drafting protractors to this design.
Reuse the broad geometric line family; the English word line here does not imply the complete infinite-straight-line subtype.
Reuse geometric figure and introduce a plane-figure family without reclassifying every existing child.
Reuse the Russian filled-disk concept, correct circle translation, and retain the original Russian label.
Reuse circle boundary and preserve circumference as an explicitly qualified homonym.
Refine diameter segment through the new chord genus, preserving its length distinction from Q12.
Reuse geometric ray with a planar genus; do not import the dictionary vector parent.
Refine width as length, preserving the broader size ancestor.
Reuse angular degree, refine its unit family, and keep temperature-degree homonyms separate.
Reuse the Q12 diameter-length concept; no duplicate is added.
Reuse the Q14 area quantity for the disk.
Point has a mixed upper/descendant review pending; use its mathematical-point meaning as an angle vertex without changing its hierarchy.
Plane remains a mathematical object; the new plane-figure class is not an alias for the plane itself.
Diagonal object/length and polygon/polyhedron scopes require a separate review.
Triangle boundary-versus-filled-region conventions need review before adding universal area or perimeter links.
RAD software development is distinct from the radian symbol rad.
The ray fish record is distinct from the geometric half-line.
Temperature degree is distinct from angular degree.
Degree in a general level/extent sense is distinct from angular degree.
The radio direction-finder meaning of goniometer is not an equivalent synonym of every angle instrument.
The dictionary curve gloss excludes constant-direction traces, whereas the selected mathematical plane-curve family includes them.
Solid angle and steradian remain separate from the plane-angle quantity and unit family.

review.limits: The graph distinguishes geometric objects, quantities and units. It does not evaluate geometry, enforce endpoints or positive-radius constraints, count two rays, or implement angle conversions. The broad angle record is preserved; only its new plane-angle subtype receives a plane-angle quantity. General boundaries, diagonal/perpendicular senses, point/plane upper genera, nonplanar and solid-angle meanings remain pending. No application test suites.

collision_decisions.circumference_length: Existing 2706 is the curve/boundary meaning. Preserve it and use explicit quantity and boundary labels.
collision_decisions.radian: RAD 1033 is a software-development acronym; the scientific unit has a distinct qualified identity. Lookup normalization does not establish semantic equivalence.

internal_homonyms.plane angle: The new plane-angle figure is distinct from the explicitly qualified quantity.

refreshed_comparison.caveat: Exact normalized English spellings are candidates, not semantic identities or a missing-concept count.

repairs.reason: A geometric disk is a plane figure; it is not a circle boundary curve. Source: https://reference.wolfram.com/language/ref/Disk.html
A circle is a closed planar curve; geometric figure remains an ancestor. OEWN 2025: oewn-13896141-n. Source: https://reference.wolfram.com/language/ref/Circle.html

A circle/sphere diameter segment is a chord through the centre; for a sphere use a great-circle section. The broad line ancestor remains. OEWN 2025: oewn-13894356-n. Source: https://mathworld.wolfram.com/Chord.html

A geometric ray is planar, while remaining within the broad line family. It is not a finite segment or a complete infinite straight line. OEWN 2025: oewn-13936442-n. Source: https://mathworld.wolfram.com/Ray.html
Width is a one-dimensional extent quantity and therefore a length; size remains an ancestor. OEWN 2025: oewn-05143415-n.

An angular degree belongs to the plane-angle unit family, while the measurement-unit ancestor remains. OEWN 2025: oewn-13632450-n. Source: https://www.bipm.org/documents/20126/41483022/SI-Brochure-9-EN.pdf
